title: Python Programming Fundamentals
description: Learn variables, loops, functions and data structures by writing small Python programs. No prior coding experience is needed.

title: Relational Databases and SQL
description: Design tables, write SELECT queries, join related tables and enforce integrity with keys and constraints.

title: Introduction to Document Databases
description: Store flexible JSON-like records, run filter queries and understand when a document model beats fixed tables.

title: Statistics for Everyday Decisions
description: Understand averages, spread, probability and sampling so you can read charts and survey results with confidence.

title: Web Basics: HTML, CSS and Layout
description: Build and style simple web pages, arrange content with flexible layouts and make pages usable on phones.

title: Cloud Computing Essentials
description: Tour virtual machines, storage, networking and billing in the cloud, and learn how to launch a small service safely.

title: Version Control with Git
description: Track changes, branch and merge work, and collaborate on shared code without overwriting each other.

title: Data Modeling for Document Stores
description: Decide when to nest related information and when to link it, and avoid records that grow without limit.

title: Query Tuning and Indexing
description: Read execution plans, build compound indexes in the right field order and remove indexes that slow down writes.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Train and evaluate classification and regression models, split data correctly and guard against overfitting.

title: Building REST and GraphQL APIs
description: Design clear endpoints, validate requests, handle errors and secure services with tokens.

title: Containers and Orchestration
description: Package applications into containers, run many copies and roll out updates without downtime.

title: Text Mining and Natural Language Processing
description: Clean raw text, turn words into numbers, classify documents and extract names, places and dates.

title: Data Pipelines and Streaming
description: Move data between systems on a schedule or continuously, handle late records and keep results reproducible.

title: Embeddings and Semantic Retrieval
description: Represent sentences as vectors so that passages with similar meaning sit close together, then find them with nearest-neighbour lookups.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
description: Split documents, find the passages that matter for a question and give them to a language model so answers cite real sources.

title: Persistent Conversation State for AI Assistants
description: Store dialogue history and learned facts across sessions so a virtual helper picks up where earlier talks left off.

title: Distributed Data at Scale
description: Spread data over many servers, keep copies in sync, survive machine failures and choose a partition key wisely.

title: Transactions and Consistency
description: Make several writes succeed or fail together, reason about isolation and design workflows that tolerate retries.

title: Observability and Reliability Engineering
description: Collect metrics, logs and traces, define service targets and respond to incidents with calm, repeatable steps.

title: Deep Learning for Vision
description: Build convolutional networks that recognise objects in photographs, and fine-tune pretrained models on small image sets.

title: Security for Data Platforms
description: Control who can read and write data with roles, encrypt traffic and storage, and audit access.
